resourcePack.patina_pandemonium.generate: Shared descriptors for nine flyweight carriers; logical variants are assembled on demand
Runtime tags for the nine flyweight carriers and vanilla connection behavior
commands.patina.invalid_source: Block %1$s is not an eligible full-block source
commands.patina.invalid_form: Unknown form; use full, slab, stairs, wall, fence, fence_gate, carpet, button, or pressure_plate
commands.patina.invalid_stage: Unknown oxidation stage; use fresh, exposed, weathered, or oxidized
commands.patina.invalid_dye: Unknown dye; use none or a vanilla dye color
container.patina_pandemonium.clear_stage: Clear every oxidation checkbox and show all stages
jei.patina_pandemonium.variant_fabricato: The Variant Fabricator converts any supported full block or item into a selected oxidation stage, wax state, dye, and construction form.
jei.patina_pandemonium.crafting_inherita: JEI distinguishes variants by their data components. Vanilla recipes remain visible normally; when crafting, any variant ingredient makes the output inherit the deepest oxidation stage. Mixing waxed and unwaxed ingredients produces an unwaxed result, and mixed dyes do not propagate.
jei.patina_pandemonium.variant_waxing: Combine one plain honeycomb with one Patina-managed item or block in any crafting grid to wax it. Vanilla copper waxing recipes keep priority and are not matched by this dynamic recipe.
jei.patina_pandemonium.variant_risks: Oxidized tools have reduced effective durability, rusty attackers and weapons can inflict Tetanus, and oxidized foods may cause Poison. Waxing reduces these risks without making a stage stronger than the preceding unwaxed stage.
